name: month_offset
description: Calendar month-name arithmetic modulo twelve, with matched input-month copying.
generator_code:
import random,json,calendar
random.seed(0)
months=list(calendar.month_name)[1:];items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 m=random.randrange(12);k=random.randint(1,24)
 stem=f'Start in {months[m]} and move forward {k} months.'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+' The resulting month is', 'answer':' '+months[(m+k)%12]})
 control.append({'prompt':stem+' The starting month is', 'answer':' '+months[m]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
